global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. A single nori sheet rests atop, in a white bowl with green patterns, set on a wooden table under warm, ambient light.

regions.background: The table is smooth, light brown wood with subtle grain patterns and warm, even lighting reflecting off its surface.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with green floral and geometric patterns along its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy white, speckled with sesame seeds, and topped with green onions and a dark seaweed sheet.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark, irregularly shaped, with a rough, slightly bubbly surface and scattered sesame seeds.
